items.quote: We hired Marvin to paint our home's exterior. He is meticulous and thoughtful. He did a beautiful job, exceeding our expectations. Truly an expert at his craft and his prices are very fair. I would not hesitate to recommend him.

Marvin is awesome! Easy to work with and communicates well throughout the process. Very reasonable and fair on pricing. He does great work as well. He's just an all around nice, honest guy! You can't go wrong using Marvin.

We are very pleased with Marvin's work. He was the easiest of three companies to get in touch with, his price was the best, and he was willing to use the paint we wanted. I highly recommend his services, and he's friendly and professional.
